correctness.rationale: The pinned result specifies an inner unit circle and outer radius R=3+ε cos(2θ), 0<ε<2/5. The normal chord is transverse because |p|<4/5, R>13/5, and |Rp/sqrt(R²+p²)|<1. The degree-one angular lift f=θ−atan(p/R)+asin(Rp/sqrt(R²+p²)) yields f′=1+R′′R(R²−1)/[W(R²+W)]+p²(W+p²)/[W(R²+p²)], W²=R²−(R²−1)p². For u=cos2θ≥0, v=p², the rational minorant W≥Ru+[R/(R+2)](1−u) and the exact square (R−R/(R+2))²(1−u)² prove f′≥1−4ε(2+ε)/(3+ε), equality only at u=1. For u≤0 direct termwise positivity holds. Hence ε_c=(√97−7)/8 is exact injectivity boundary: derivative >0 below, two isolated zeros at equality with strictly monotone lift, negative at extrema and positive at minima above; extrema multipliers still in (−1,0) above threshold. sign(f−θ)=sign(p), giving the four fixed points and monotone convergence on invariant semicircles through the endpoint.
